#### AsyncStrategy

```swift
@MainActor protocol AsyncStrategy : AnyObject
```

Owns read, write, and external side effects for `@AsyncState` Addresses. The Environment owns one instance per type and always holds the Value.


#### ComputationEnvironment

```swift
@MainActor final class ComputationEnvironment
```

A counter part provided into the closure of the the ``Computed`` responsible for connection to the ``SharedEnvironment``. Restricts what ``Computed`` can access from the ``SharedEnvironment`` without drifting from it.


#### Computed

```swift
@MainActor @propertyWrapper final class Computed<Key, Output> where Key : Hashable
```

A value derived from other values, that is kept up to date automatically. The function that derives the new value is provided with the ``ComputationEnvironment`` instance and whenever reads other values registers as a `dependant` of them. Whenever any of those values change, the value of the ``Computed`` is invalidated and will be recalculated on the next read. As other states in container, readers are notified when value changes.

Conforms to: `Sendable`, `SendableMetatype`.

```swift
@MainActor init(wrappedValue: @escaping (ComputationEnvironment) -> Output) where Key == NoKey
@MainActor init(wrappedValue: @escaping (ComputationEnvironment, Key) -> Output)
@MainActor let wrappedValue: (ComputationEnvironment, Key) -> Output
@MainActor var projectedValue: Computed<Key, Output> { get }
```
